goals: implement hierarchical drilldown (UF -> City -> Zone -> Section -> Urna) in dashboard
implement PDF report generation with dual-mode (ABNT A4 + Statistical)
enable raw log viewing for specific section/urna in the UI
generate a global First Round (1T) overview report
constraints: maintain PT-BR localization for all reports and UI
ensure PDF generation is on-demand via dashboard buttons
use absolute paths for all data fetching and report saving
acceptance_criteria: successful PDF generation for all hierarchy levels
raw logs correctly filtered by section/urna in the UI
standardized ABNT layout for per-urna/section reports
chosen_approach: Streamlit multipage or tab-based drilldown with a background ReportingEngine for PDF generation using reportlab/weasyprint
